page_title: NIC 3-0 LOR | Nice v Lorient 19/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Jeremy Stinat is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar.
90+3' Evann Guessand (Nice) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Here's the change. Imran Louza leaves the pitch and Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) comes on as a substitute.
89' 3 - 0 Goal! Jean-Clair Todibo provides Evann Guessand (Nice) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
88' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Marcin Bulka makes a comfortable save.
86' Evann Guessand (Nice) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the left post.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.
84' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Lorient will have a corner.

83' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Yvon Mvogo inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save.
80' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) is flagged for offside.
78' Substitution. Ayman Kari did his best and is replaced by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antoine Mendy (Nice) will replace Jordan Lotomba.
75' Melvin Bard (Nice) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
72' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) replaces Morgan Sanson.
71' Substitution. Evann Guessand (Nice) on for Terem Moffi.
71' Formose Mendy (Lorient) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
69' The resulting set piece from Lorient is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

69' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Imran Louza (Lorient) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Lorient force a corner. They send men into the box.
66' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 55:45.
63' It will be a substitution. Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) is ready to enter the pitch as Panos Katseris walks off.
62' Substitution. Theo Le Bris is replaced by Benjamin Mendy (Lorient).
62' Here is a change. Mohamed Bamba is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).
62' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
60' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Yvon Mvogo makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mohamed-Ali Cho walks off the pitch to be replaced by Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
59' Khephren Thuram is substituted due to injury. Francesco Farioli gives a chance to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
58' Looks like Khephren Thuram (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
57' That's a clear yellow card. Ayman Kari (Lorient) goes into the book.
53' 2 - 0 Goal! Jeremie Boga (Nice) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:0.
49' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Imran Louza (Lorient) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Marcin Bulka.
42' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
40' Morgan Sanson (Nice) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box.
37' Khephren Thuram (Nice) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.

35' He should have scored! Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Yvon Mvogo makes an easy save.
33' Nice enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
30' Lorient fail to score from a corner as Marcin Bulka (Nice) leaps to collect the ball.
29' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Lorient.
25' The total number of attempts is 5:2.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Morgan Sanson (Nice) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 1:0.
21' PENALTY APPEAL after Khephren Thuram (Nice) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
18' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

18' Yvon Mvogo pulls off a brilliant save! Khephren Thuram (Nice) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Jeremie Boga (Nice) does well to evade a couple of challenges then let's fly from distance towards goal, but the effort flies just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
14' Terem Moffi (Nice) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
12' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is adjudged offside.
11' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
8' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Nice will take a corner kick.
8' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is able to continue to play.
7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
6' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
4' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nice will kick the game off.
Jeremy Stinat is introduced as the referee for today's match.
